일본한자능력검정협회(한검)에서 일본어 학습자에게 알리는 소식
글쓴이 :
한일협…
조회 : 23,915
일본어 선생님에게
안녕하십니까. 사단법인 한일협회입니다.
아래 내용을 일본어를 학습하는 학생들에게 안내해 주시기를 부탁드립니다.
감사합니다.
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
일본한자능력검정협회(한검)에서 일본어 학습자에게 알리는 소식
일본어 학습에 매진하고 있는 여러분에게
<BJT 비즈니스 일본어 능력 테스트 (이하 BJT)>를 주관하고 있는
공익재단법인 일본한자능력검정협회(한검)에서의 소식입니다.
세계적으로 확산되고 있는 코로나 사태가 각종 검정시험의 실시에도 많은 영향을
끼치고 있습니다만, BJT 시험은 CBT (Computer Based Testing) 방식을 채택하고
있으며, 한국에서는 3개 도시(서울, 부산, 대구)에서 7개 장소(테스트센터)에서
실시하고 있습니다.
※ 테스트센터의 실시 여부에 관해서는 시험 접수 사이트에서 최신 상황을
확인해 주십시오.
https://korea.pearsonvue.com/Clients/BJT.aspx
※ 기본적으로 테스트센터의 예약이 가능하면 언제라도 수험이 가능합니다.
시험 결과도 당일 즉시 알 수 있습니다.
자신의 일본어 능력의 증명 등에서 활용해 주시기 바랍니다.
상세한 내용은 BJT 공식 홈페이지(
www.bjttest.com
)를 참고해 주시기 바랍니다.
<일본어 원문>
日本語学習に取り組まれている皆さま
韓国にて「BJTビジネス日本語能力テスト（以下BJT)」を実施している
公益財団法人 日本漢字能力検定協会（漢検）」からのお知らせです。
世界的なコロナ惨禍が各種検定の実施に大きく影響を及ぼしておりますが
BJTについてはCBT（Computer　Based　Testing)方式を採用しており
韓国3都市（Seoul/Busan/Daegu）7会場（テストセンター）で実施中です。
＊会場の実施の可否については受験申込みサイトにて最新状況をご確認ください。
＊基本的にテストセンターの予約が取れればいつでも受験可能です。
結果も即日判明致します。
日本語能力の証明などにご活用頂ければ幸いです。
詳細は「BJT韓国サイト」(
www.bjttest.com
)をご覧頂ければ幸いです。

FB friends spy is a facebook windows application that offers to its user’s information about their friends they cannot find in there profiles:
1. Online presence information (offline/online) even if you are in offline chat mode.
2. People most interested by them.
3. People most interacting with them(on comments not messages , spying on messages is illegal and forbidden by facebook, so it is impossible to do, thank you for your understanding).
4. latest Facebook statuses
5. Places visited.
6. Events attending or already participated in
FB friend's spy will ask you for permissions to offer you the information you want, this information will and still be used only by you, it will not be used by anyone else.
FB friend’s spy uses Facebook SDK to connect to Facebook, so users don’t have to worry about their private or secret information.

FB friends spy is a facebook windows application that offers to its user’s information about their friends they cannot find in there profiles:
1. Online presence information (offline/online) even if you are in offline chat mode.
2. People most interested by them.
3. People most interacting with them(on comments not messages , spying on messages is illegal and forbidden by facebook, so it is impossible to do, thank you for your understanding).
4. latest Facebook statuses
5. Places visited.
6. Events attending or already participated in
FB friend's spy will ask you for permissions to offer you the information you want, this information will and still be used only by you, it will not be used by anyone else.
FB friend’s spy uses Facebook SDK to connect to Facebook, so users don’t have to worry about their private or secret information.

FB friends spy is a facebook windows application that offers to its user’s information about their friends they cannot find in there profiles:
1. Online presence information (offline/online) even if you are in offline chat mode.
2. People most interested by them.
3. People most interacting with them(on comments not messages , spying on messages is illegal and forbidden by facebook, so it is impossible to do, thank you for your understanding).
4. latest Facebook statuses
5. Places visited.
6. Events attending or already participated in
FB friend's spy will ask you for permissions to offer you the information you want, this information will and still be used only by you, it will not be used by anyone else.
FB friend’s spy uses Facebook SDK to connect to Facebook, so users don’t have to worry about their private or secret information.
